intro: Bold, fermented and spicy, eaten with a table full of free banchan side dishes. K-dramas made Korean BBQ and fried chicken global.
flavours: Gochujang, gochugaru (chilli flakes), doenjang, garlic, sesame oil, kimchi
hk: Kimberley Street in Tsim Sha Tsui is Hong Kong's 'Koreatown', full of BBQ, fried chicken and Korean grocers.

dishes.name: Kimchi
dishes.what: Fermented napa cabbage with chilli, garlic and fish sauce; served with every meal.

dishes.name: Bibimbap
dishes.what: Rice bowl with vegetables, beef and a fried egg; mix it all with gochujang. Dolsot version comes sizzling in a stone pot.

dishes.name: Bulgogi
dishes.what: 'Fire meat': thin slices of sweet soy-marinated beef, grilled or pan-fried.

dishes.name: Samgyeopsal
dishes.what: Thick pork belly strips grilled at the table, wrapped in lettuce with garlic and ssamjang.

dishes.name: Tteokbokki
dishes.what: Chewy rice cakes in a sweet, spicy red gochujang sauce, with fish cakes.

dishes.name: Japchae
dishes.what: Glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables, beef and sesame oil.

dishes.name: Kimchi jjigae
dishes.what: Spicy stew of aged kimchi, pork and tofu.

dishes.name: Sundubu-jjigae
dishes.what: Spicy soft tofu stew served boiling, with a raw egg cracked in.

dishes.name: Korean fried chicken
dishes.what: Double-fried, ultra-crunchy chicken, plain or glazed in sweet-spicy yangnyeom sauce; best with beer ('chimaek').

dishes.name: Naengmyeon
dishes.what: Chewy buckwheat noodles in an icy, tangy beef broth, a summer favourite.

dishes.name: Samgyetang
dishes.what: Whole young chicken stuffed with sticky rice and ginseng, eaten on the hottest days.

dishes.name: Gimbap
dishes.what: Seaweed rice rolls with sesame oil and fillings like egg, pickled radish and spinach.
